scope: Read-only independent source review of automatic host signing, stored credential/origin binding, managed startup and cancellation boundaries.
observations: Signer validates the complete nine-split-item domain-separated transcript, configured origin, identity, name, platform, challenge ID, canonical nonce and bounded expiration before pure Ed25519 signing.
Managed registration refuses redirect following or stored origin/key mismatch, reuses a healthy bearer and performs same-key recovery only after HTTP 401.
Managed origin selection prefers the protected existing registration binding, otherwise the publisher profile; no administrator enrollment fallback is called by the managed path.
Ready UI events require the current generation and Preparing state; Stop closes local grant authority immediately, moves to Stopping and waits for Finished.
The host attempts bounded active-session teardown and latches restart-required if it cannot confirm completion; preflight cancellation awaits cleanup of its owned encoder child.
limitations: Source review is not native Windows execution, installed-app UI proof, real phone access or production Internet/TURN verification.
The 90-second client expiration check tolerates bounded clock skew; the coordinator enforces its own strict 60-second challenge lifetime.
